```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library("ggplot2")
library(DESeq2)
library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
```

##Load count matrix

```{r}
counts <- read.csv(file.path(getwd(),"gene_counts_matrix.csv"), row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

sample_info <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(counts),
  condition = c("QE", "QE", "QE", "QL1", "QL1", "QL1", "QL2", "QL2", "QL2", "W", "W","W"),
  sample_names = colnames(counts),
  row.names = "sample"
)

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts,
  colData = sample_info,
  design = ~ condition   
)

#filter out very low-count genes before running DE
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= min(table(sample_info$condition))

```

## Create PCA plot
```{r PCA, echo=FALSE}
rld <- rlog(dds, blind=TRUE)

plotPCA(rld, intgroup='condition', ntop=500)
```

## Create Heatmap
heatmap based of default euclidean distance
```{r Heatmap, echo=FALSE}
rld_mat <- assay(rld)
sampleDists <- dist((t(rld_mat)))
sampleDistMatrix <- as.matrix(sampleDists)

head(sampleDistMatrix)
head(sample_info)
rownames(sample_info)
ann_col <- sample_info %>%
  tibble::remove_rownames() %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_names") %>%
  dplyr::select(condition)

pheatmap(sampleDistMatrix, annotation_col = ann_col)
colnames(sampleDistMatrix)

all(rownames(ann_col) %in% colnames(sampleDistMatrix))
all(colnames(sampleDistMatrix) %in% rownames(ann_col))


sample_info
```

## ASCA
Create an asca representation of the data
```{r}
group  <- factor(sub("_.*", "", colnames(counts)))
counts <- counts[rowSums(counts >= 10) >= 3, ]
X      <- t(vst(counts, blind = TRUE))          # samples x genes (matrix)


dat   <- data.frame(group = group, row.names = rownames(X))
dat$Y <- X


mod <- asca(Y ~ group, data = dat)              
print(mod)
summary(mod)                                    # variance explained per effect


sc   <- scores(mod,      factor = 1)            # one row per group level (in level order)
ld   <- loadings(mod,    factor = 1)            # genes x components
proj <- proj <- scale(X, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE) %*% ld           # individual samples 


cols <- seq_along(levels(group)) + 1           
pdf("DEG_results/ASCA_multiblock_plots.pdf", width = 7, height = 6)
plot(proj[, 1], proj[, 2], col = cols[group], pch = 19, cex = 1.3,
     xlab = "Component 1", ylab = "Component 2", main = "ASCA group effect")
points(sc[, 1], sc[, 2], col = cols, pch = 4, cex = 2.5, lwd = 3)   # group scores
legend("topright", legend = c(levels(group), "Group score"),
       col = c(cols, "black"), pch = c(rep(19, length(cols)), 4), bty = "n")
loadingplot(mod, factor = 1)                    # genes, so no group legend needed
dev.off()

#representation in R
plot(proj[, 1], proj[, 2], col = cols[group], pch = 19, cex = 1.3,
     xlab = "Component 1", ylab = "Component 2", main = "ASCA group effect")
points(sc[, 1], sc[, 2], col = cols, pch = 4, cex = 2.5, lwd = 3)   # group scores
legend("topright", legend = c(levels(group), "Group score"),
       col = c(cols, "black"), pch = c(rep(19, length(cols)), 4), bty = "n")


```
